review_batches.context: Read all298 rows plus complete Leone finale/Kasumi Earth ending. Liebhofen leaves as Vorlia collapses, Fain challenges Xiujian then sees his bleeding hand; classroom return, concealed Woman/Wenimas explanation and quantum-world exposition.
review_batches.decisions: This is the Ai Earth-ending route, not a continuation of every partner finale. Bleeding is explicit but its cause is not supplied. Ymir's promise is reassurance, not proof all absentees already returned. Preserve fragmented teacher speech without inventing a lesson. Hidden ????? and Woman labels remain until source changes. Wenimas's quantum/state-vector model is fictional dialogue, not corrected into a scientific lecture.
